map.斜距化平距（本页代码口径，垂直角按度输入先化弧度）：水平距离 H=斜距 S×co: Slope distance to horizontal distance (this page, vertical angle in degrees converted to radians): horizontal distance H = slope distance S×cos(vertical angle); linked values: height difference Δh = S×sin(vertical angle), difference S−H, slope-to-horizontal ratio = S÷H. Validation: slope distance must be >0 and the vertical angle must be between 0° and 90° (exclusive), otherwise a message is shown. Criteria: no fixed classification; at 0° the horizontal distance equals the slope distance and height difference is 0; as the angle grows, horizontal distance shrinks and height difference grows.

map.斜距 100.5m、俯角 5.71%（≈天顶距 84.29°）→ 水平距=100: Slant 100.5 m, depression 5.71% (≈ zenith 84.29°) → horizontal = 100.5×sin(84.29°) = 100.0 m.
map.10% 坡下斜距比水平距长约 0.5%，大坡（30%）差达 15%，必须改化。: At 10% slope the slant is about 0.5% longer than horizontal; at large slopes (30%) the gap reaches 15%, so reduction is mandatory.
map.面积/坐标全偏大，坡地工程差异显著，须先改化再算。: Areas / coordinates are all overstated; on slopes the difference is significant, so reduce before computing.
